Hi Marta —

Thanks again for moving this forward. We want to make the SOC 2 / DPA review + pen-test intake as low-friction as possible while keeping everyone in the right ops lanes.   • Covers SOC 2 scoping, DPA review, evidence handoff, and initial pen-test Qs

Option B — two focused 45-min sessions (preferred for smaller attendee groups)
  • Part 1: Tue Aug 10, 14:00–14:45 UTC (16:00–16:45 CEST) — controls + evidence mapping (SOC 2 / DPA)
  • Part 2: Wed Aug 11, 14:00–14:45 UTC (16:00–16:45 CEST) — pen-test scoping & vendor coordination

Slot-barter idea (if helpful): if ShieldBank can take an evening CET slot (we can offer 18:30–20:00 CEST on one of the dates), we can split items into shorter focused sessions and pre-send an MAP (mutual action plan) so the call runs to the checklist.

Attachments: shieldbank-MAP-draft.pdf (draft MAP), walkthrough-agenda.md (detailed agenda)

Short internal note: Jasmine — will you add the pen vendor contact if ShieldBank wants them on Part 2? Rishi — can you reserve a 30-min contingency slot the same week in case the team needs an extension?

If none of the times work, flag preferred windows and we’ll do a quick swap.

Thanks,
